name: BOUGHT-YOURS-the-old-word
old: bought: 'You bought this one today. You can buy each piece once a day.'
note: the refusal that read as "you have one already"

name: BOUGHT-YOURS-heavy-marks
old: if (!canCarry(sale.give, rest)) return { ok: false, reason: 'heavy' };
new: if (!canCarry(sale.give, rest)) { markBrokerBought(offer); return { ok: false, reason: 'heavy' }; }
note: a sale refused as too heavy marks the offer: Bought, and no piece

name: BOUGHT-YOURS-marks-without-giving
note: the stones taken and the offer marked, the piece never given

name: BOUGHT-YOURS-record-kept-on-its-old-day
note: a sale three days on joins the old day's record, so today's offer reads unbought after it was sold

name: BOUGHT-YOURS-dismantle-frees-the-day
note: the player's reading made law: a dismantle frees the day's mark (SS5 keeps it)

name: BOUGHT-YOURS-record-read-on-any-day
note: another day's marks read as today's (the ids carry their day, so no offer of today's would match - but the record answers for its own day alone)
